name: singlet_doublets_expression_doublet_scoring
title: Expression-based per-cell doublet scoring
description: Scores each barcode of one library's raw UMI counts by how much its expression resembles a mixture of two cells, and writes a continuous per-barcode score (higher is more doublet-like) with the simulated-score distribution and a parameter record. Needs integer counts in layers/counts for barcodes already called as cells; set sample_key when the dataset merges libraries so each is scored separately. The default method scrublet is closed-form and needs no training; solo needs a fitted scVI model at models/<solo.scvi_model_key>. It makes no labels (use doublets.doublet_call_thresholding); do not use it on empty droplets or as a replacement for hashing or genotype labels.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Detector. scrublet (default, closed-form), doubletfinder, scdblfinder, solo (needs solo.scvi_model_key). Scores are on method-specific scales.

sample_key.description: obs column naming each library; each is scored separately. Set it whenever the dataset merges libraries. Null treats the dataset as one library.

expected_doublet_rate.description: Expected doublet rate rho: the prior for scrublet; recorded for every method and passed to doublets.doublet_call_thresholding.

scrublet.description: Options used only when method is scrublet.

sim_doublet_ratio.description: Simulated doublets per observed barcode, r.

n_neighbors.description: Base neighbour count k0. Null uses round(0.5 * sqrt(n)).

n_prin_comps.description: Principal components of the merged embedding; must be below the number of barcodes and genes.

min_gene_variability_pctl.description: Genes below this variability percentile are dropped before simulation.

use_approx_neighbors.description: Approximate neighbour lookup (true) or exact (false); exact scales quadratically with barcodes.

doubletfinder.description: Options used only when method is doubletfinder.

pN.description: Artificial doublets as a fraction of the merged real plus artificial data.

pK.description: Neighbourhood fraction. Null runs the BCmvn sweep and records the chosen value.

n_prin_comps.description: Principal components used for pANN. The reference has no default; singlet uses 30.

use_approx_neighbors.description: Approximate neighbour lookup (true) or the exact dense distance matrix (false).

scdblfinder.description: Options used only when method is scdblfinder.

dbr_per_1k.description: Expected doublet rate per thousand cells; halve it for high-throughput 10x chips.

solo.description: Options used only when method is solo.

scvi_model_key.description: Key of a fitted scVI model at models/<key>. Required when method is solo.

doublet_ratio.description: Simulated doublets per observed barcode used to train the classifier.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for pair sampling, neighbour lookup and classifier training; recorded in uns/doublet_params_<method>.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace the obs and uns members written by a previous run of this tool instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/doublet_score_scrublet. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, route, libraries_scored, barcodes_scored, simulated_doublets, expected_doublet_rate, score_column, score_min, score_median, score_max. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
